versions.content: EcucModuleDef includes standardized and vendor-specific parameter definitions The EcucModuleDef , to which the EcucModuleConfig- urationValues is associated to, is specified by the implementor of the according Software Module. Therefore the EcucModuleDef includes standardized as well as vendor-specific parameter definitions.
